title: 埃博拉病房内：死者与生者同处一室，医院如何应对？
speaker: Declan Walsh

segments.en: We walked into this Ebola ward it was very striking that in this confined space you had a grown man being treated you had this young child who just arrived and you had a person who had died of Ebola lying in that same space.
segments.zh: 我们走进这间埃博拉病房，令人震惊的是，在这个狭小的空间里，有一个成年男子在接受治疗，有一个刚到的孩子，还有一个死于埃博拉的人躺在同一个地方。

segments.en: The hospital doesn't even have the resources to feed patients people's relatives have to come to the Ebola ward just to bring them bottles of water and food.
segments.zh: 医院甚至没有资源为患者提供食物，家属不得不来到埃博拉病房，只为给他们送水和食物。

segments.en: That particular hospital was I would say completely overwhelmed when we arrived it's just it's the main public hospital in a town a gold mining town called Mangwalu that's about 50 miles north of here that's where this outbreak is believed to have started and as long as two months ago and the when we arrived there the frankly the public health facilities appear to be in crisis as you see there was only protective equipment.
segments.zh: 那家医院在我们到达时已经完全不堪重负。那是曼格瓦卢镇的主要公立医院，一个金矿小镇，疫情据信早在两个月前就已开始。我们到达时，公共卫生设施显然处于危机状态，只有防护装备。

segments.en: For medical staff like doctors but otherwise those words were not secured. There was very minimal care being given to patients and then you had relatives and other folks just walking in and out and they seem to be entirely unprotected and of course that was putting them at great risk and of course increasing the possibility that the hospital itself would be a source of transmission back out into the community.
segments.zh: 只有医生等医务人员有防护，其他区域没有安全保障。患者得到的护理极少，家属和其他人随意进出，似乎完全没有防护，这使他们面临巨大风险，也增加了医院成为传播源、将病毒传回社区的可能性。
